help_topics.title: Understanding inventory quantity categories
help_topics.business_question: Why can on-hand and available inventory differ?
help_topics.plain_answer: On-hand means product physically at a location. Allocated means quantity reserved to leave; in-transit means quantity expected to arrive. The vendor describes available as on-hand minus allocated minus suspense. Movement code changes these categories separately, and selected availability checks can include in-transit quantity when the location rule permits it.

help_topics.title: Understanding lot creation and cleanup

help_topics.plain_answer: A lot identifies a group of product. Movement helpers can create a missing lot and attach supplied attributes.
